exception_request_decision_consistent.name: exception_request_decision_consistent
exception_request_decision_consistent.value: "exception_request"."status" <> 'PENDING' or ("exception_request"."decided_by" is null and "exception_request"."decided_at" is null)

guarantor_invitation_terminal_state_excl.name: guarantor_invitation_terminal_state_exclusive
guarantor_invitation_terminal_state_excl.value: not ("guarantor_invitation"."claimed_at" is not null and "guarantor_invitation"."revoked_at" is not null)

vehicle_assignment_reassignment_consiste.name: vehicle_assignment_reassignment_consistent
vehicle_assignment_reassignment_consiste.value: ("vehicle_assignment"."supersedes_assignment_id" is null and "vehicle_assignment"."reassignment_approved_by" is null and "vehicle_assignment"."reassignment_reason" is null) or ("vehicle_assignment"."supersedes_assignment_id" is not null and "vehicle_assignment"."reassignment_approved_by" is not null and length(btrim("vehicle_assignment"."reassignment_reason")) > 0)

vehicle_reassignment_approval_approved_c.name: vehicle_reassignment_approval_approved_consistent
vehicle_reassignment_approval_approved_c.value: ("vehicle_reassignment_approval"."status" <> 'APPROVED' and "vehicle_reassignment_approval"."approved_by" is null and "vehicle_reassignment_approval"."approved_at" is null) or ("vehicle_reassignment_approval"."status" = 'APPROVED' and "vehicle_reassignment_approval"."approved_by" is not null and "vehicle_reassignment_approval"."approved_by_role" is not null and "vehicle_reassignment_approval"."approved_at" is not null)

asset_contract_command_actor_exclusive.name: asset_contract_command_actor_exclusive
asset_contract_command_actor_exclusive.value: ("asset_contract_command"."actor_staff_user_id" is not null) <> ("asset_contract_command"."actor_person_id" is not null)

outbox_attempt_outcome_consistent.name: outbox_attempt_outcome_consistent
outbox_attempt_outcome_consistent.value:
(
        ("outbox_attempt"."outcome" = 'STARTED' and "outbox_attempt"."finished_at" is null and "outbox_attempt"."failure_code" is null and "outbox_attempt"."next_attempt_at" is null)
        or ("outbox_attempt"."outcome" = 'ABANDONED' and "outbox_attempt"."finished_at" is not null and "outbox_attempt"."failure_code" is not null and "outbox_attempt"."next_attempt_at" is null)
        or ("outbox_attempt"."outcome" = 'PUBLISHED' and "outbox_attempt"."finished_at" is not null and "outbox_attempt"."failure_code" is null and "outbox_attempt"."next_attempt_at" is null)
        or ("outbox_attempt"."outcome" = 'RETRY_SCHEDULED' and "outbox_attempt"."finished_at" is not null and "outbox_attempt"."failure_code" is not null and "outbox_attempt"."next_attempt_at" is not null)
        or ("outbox_attempt"."outcome" = 'EXCEPTION' and "outbox_attempt"."finished_at" is not null and "outbox_attempt"."failure_code" is not null and "outbox_attempt"."next_attempt_at" is null)
      )

outbox_claim_consistent.name: outbox_claim_consistent
outbox_claim_consistent.value:
(
        ("outbox_message"."claimed_by" is null and "outbox_message"."claim_token" is null and "outbox_message"."claimed_at" is null)
        or ("outbox_message"."claimed_by" is not null and "outbox_message"."claim_token" is not null and "outbox_message"."claimed_at" is not null)
      )

outbox_terminal_state_exclusive.name: outbox_terminal_state_exclusive
outbox_terminal_state_exclusive.value: not ("outbox_message"."published_at" is not null and "outbox_message"."exception_at" is not null)

payment_adjustment_decision_consistent.name: payment_adjustment_decision_consistent
payment_adjustment_decision_consistent.value: "payment_adjustment"."status" = 'PENDING' or ("payment_adjustment"."checker_staff_user_id" is not null and "payment_adjustment"."decision_at" is not null)

document_accepted_has_clean_evidence.name: document_accepted_has_clean_evidence
document_accepted_has_clean_evidence.value: "privacy"."document"."status" <> 'ACCEPTED' or ("privacy"."document"."malware_scanned" and "privacy"."document"."sha256" is not null and "privacy"."document"."accepted_object_key" is not null and "privacy"."document"."accepted_object_version_id" is not null and "privacy"."document"."accepted_object_etag" is not null)

identity_check_final_result_complete.name: identity_check_final_result_complete
identity_check_final_result_complete.value: "privacy"."identity_check"."status" = 'PENDING' or ("privacy"."identity_check"."provider_reference" is not null and "privacy"."identity_check"."checked_at" is not null) or ("privacy"."identity_check"."status" = 'FAILED' and "privacy"."identity_check"."checked_at" is not null)

financing_rule_approval_actor_separate.name: financing_rule_approval_actor_separate
financing_rule_approval_actor_separate.value: "financing_rule_version"."requested_by" is null or "financing_rule_version"."approved_by" is null or "financing_rule_version"."requested_by" <> "financing_rule_version"."approved_by"

financing_rule_effective_window_ordered.name: financing_rule_effective_window_ordered
financing_rule_effective_window_ordered.value: "financing_rule_version"."effective_until" is null or "financing_rule_version"."effective_from" is null or "financing_rule_version"."effective_until" > "financing_rule_version"."effective_from"
